entity: Dow's Plaquemine, Louisiana plant: its 2023 ethylene oxide air release and national share
what_we_add: 34,369 lb full-year TRI figure, 21% of the 2023 national total, 8.7x its 2015-22 high, back to 2,433 lb in 2024
why: CSB puts the July 2023 incident at 31,525 lb of EtO (within 25% of our annual figure, different definition), and Hunterbrook names Dow Plaquemine the biggest 2023 EtO releaser. Same entity, same finding, same direction; the national-share and multiple-of-baseline numbers are ours.
